Here are some of the best, most reliable websites to buy beauty products online (grouped by what they’re best for). Availability can vary by country, so if you tell me your location I can tailor this list.

## Best all‑around beauty retailers
- **Sephora** – Huge selection across makeup, skincare, fragrance; strong reviews/ratings; good samples and rewards.
- **Ulta Beauty** – Great mix of prestige + drugstore; frequent sales/coupons; strong rewards.

## Best for skincare + hard‑to‑find/derm brands
- **Dermstore** – Curated skincare focus (including professional/derm brands); frequent promos.
- **Skinstore** – Broad skincare catalog; often has good deals.
- **Paula’s Choice (brand site)** – Excellent exfoliants/actives; frequent discounts and value sets.
- **La Roche-Posay / CeraVe / Avène (official sites)** – Good for sensitive-skin staples and guaranteed authenticity.

## Best for Korean & Japanese beauty
- **Olive Young Global** – Popular Korean brands; frequent bundles and promotions.
- **YesStyle** – Big K‑beauty/J‑beauty selection; good prices (shipping times vary).
- **StyleKorean / Stylevana** – Often some of the lowest prices; shipping can be slower depending on stock.

## Best for clean/indie + curated brands
- **Credo Beauty** – “Clean” focused, curated assortment; strong brand integrity.
- **Violet Grey** – High-end, editor‑curated luxury.
- **Space NK** – Great for niche/luxury skincare and makeup.

## Best for fragrance
- **FragranceNet / FragranceX** – Often discounted; check return policies and seller details.
- **LuckyScent** – Niche fragrance and samples/decants.
- **Official brand sites** (e.g., Dior, Chanel, Le Labo) – Best for authenticity and exclusive sets.

## Best for deals (use with a little caution)
- **LookFantastic** – Frequent promo codes; broad selection.
- **Beauty Bay** – Strong for palettes, tools, and deals (varies by region).
- **Brand official sites** – Often the best sales around major holidays, plus gift-with-purchase.

## Best for drugstore basics
- **Target / Walgreens / CVS / Boots (UK)** – Easy returns; frequent promotions and multipacks.
- **Amazon** – Convenient, but stick to **brand storefronts** or **“Sold by Amazon”** where possible to reduce counterfeit risk.

### Quick tips to avoid fakes and bad buys
- Prefer **official retailers/brand sites**, especially for luxury and sunscreen.
- Check **return policy**, **shipping times**, and whether products are **sealed**.
- Be wary of prices that are “too good to be true,” especially on marketplaces.

If you share your country/region and what you’re shopping for (skincare, makeup, hair, fragrance; budget; any sensitivities), I can recommend the best 5–10 sites for you specifically.
